notes.title: language update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111424/174b1bcf1ddd3d80195ba2b2548cb81f62c799b2.png[/img]

[b][h1]Americas Tower Simulator has been translated into[/h1]:[/b]

English
Simplified Chinese
French
Italian
Japanese
German
Russian
Portuguese

[b]Our goal is to make Americas Tower Simulator accessible to everyone![/b]

[h2]Important:[/h2]

Only the user interface has been translated into the aforementioned languages. Voiceovers and voice commands are currently only available in English. In the future, we plan to implement voice recognition for all the aforementioned languages.

notes.title: Version 1.5 (Demo) is cleared to make a straight in approach!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111424/a7779498a23e78618f1a8b9716905f78cd17151a.png[/img]

We are glad to announce that version 1.5 (Demo) is clear to make a straight in approach!

features added:

-Porcedural voice recognition (English only)
-Radar View (Ground, Air)
-Airdrome Tour online (available in full version)
-VFR Flights (Available in full version)
-New airdrome design

Americas tower simulator is been made with great passion for aviation, our goal is to deliver a product we can feel proud of.  A product in which you can feel like an Air Traffic Controller.

We want to let you know that our shift have not ended yet, and we will continue working to deliver a full product this year 2023.

Thanks for all your help and support up until this point, we truly appreaciated it! 

Dev Team

notes.title: Voice Recognition is been worked on!
notes.content:
We want to let you know that we are working on implementing a full voice recognition feature for americas tomwer simulator,  the update will be released soon for testing.

we are also working on americas tower akademy, wich is a personal space for you to learn terms of air traffic controller, such as phraseology, air traffic service and more.thanks for your support!

notes.title: procedural Operations has landed for testing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111424/9bdf7f30db8989ad6342f8263cb9488f4f2c9999.png[/img]


From January 22 to January 27, the procedural Operations mode will be available for testing and practice!

This new mode will allow you to practice real ATC situations as every session will be different and unique,  the sessions last a bit over an 45 minutes, and will requiered full concentration so you can keep your situational awareness on point to handle the 23 deparing/landing traffic.



This mode was early opened for the candidates participating to be hired as ATC on the dominican Republic.
 

Time: 45 Mins
Traffic: IFR/VFR
Conditions: VMC 
Ground Traffic: 16
Landing Traffic: 7
Situations: N/A
Emergencys: N/A
Lenguaje: Inglish

DISCLAIMER: The procedural operations mode is in a work in progress state, so there may be bugs or unwanted behaviors during gameplay, if you find any bugs please let us know at:

wellington.hiciano25@gmail.com 
getcomponentstudio@gmail.com
